whyV7CarriedTheDefect.theMode: AUTHORSHIP (freeze §7.2.2): carried versus authored. v7 rewrote this leaf to repair the vacuity class and carried the adjacent verification-status sentence unchanged from v5. A delta's value field is nonetheless what the successor ASSERTS, so the carried sentence became a fresh assertion made after the review that falsified it.
whyV7CarriedTheDefect.theLesson: a repair keyed on one defect class must still recompute the OTHER measurements living in the leaf it rewrites. This is v7's own lesson to v6, applied one remove further.

howThisRepairWasScoped.basis: the DEFECT CLASS -- verification-status assertions in the RESOLVED value -- derived by predicate sweep plus sentence-level reading, never by grepping the falsified sentence.
howThisRepairWasScoped.predicateInput: every string leaf of the resolved value, whitespace-folded (§7.7), case-insensitive
howThisRepairWasScoped.spellingAssumptions: these predicates are spelling-bound in the way ADV-EIR7-01 warns about: they assume English negation vocabulary (no/none/never/not/un-) adjacent to verification vocabulary (verify/reproduce/confirm/review/re-run). A carrier spelled outside that vocabulary would be missed; every candidate found was read in full, but the sweep's reach is bounded by these spellings and this is a disclosed limitation, not a proof of absence.

EXACTLY 1 asserts a falsified status: $.declaredUnresolvedDependencies.entries[4].reproductionStatusInV5, the B-EIR7-01 site. resolverStatus.finding: this lineage declares operation paths in RFC 6901 JSON-Pointer form. Both corpus resolvers (check-completeness.py, check-completeness-v2.py) walk dotted paths only and mis-tokenise a pointer path into a single bogus step; measured 2026-08-12: they refuse this lineage's set operations loudly and would apply its add operations by inventing a literal slash-named top-level key. The full measurement, including the corpus-wide three-dialect census, is recorded in artifacts/r1-lifetime-neutrality.conformance.v1.9.corpus-resolution.v1.json.
resolverStatus.consequence: until the instruments learn the dialect -- a deliberate, reviewed act under freeze §7.3 / CMP-IR-01 precedent, never a quiet patch -- the §7.3 rider-3 apply gate ('execute the resolver and require a POSITIVE resolution') cannot be satisfied for ANY artifact of this lineage, including this one. Independent pointer-correct resolution evidence exists at the v7 review (full chain, 0 errors) and was reproduced during this authoring. This is an instrument finding, not a property of these bytes.

operations.from: CHANGED IN v5, STATED PLAINLY: THIS PASS REPRODUCED THE PINNED VALUE. Serializing the pinned EP8-POS-NOMATCH-PASS bundle object with sorted keys, compact separators and ASCII output and hashing it yields exactly sha256:cc27c2beef32f3343d167c5727aa255b51884993ca416c4a862388e3be96a829 -- the value evidence.v10 pins. That is the SECOND reproduction ever; v1's was the first and no reviewer has verified either. v1's own caveats carry forward UNNARROWED: the bundle is pure ASCII, so this measurement cannot distinguish escaping policies for non-ASCII and cannot distinguish key-sort by Unicode scalar value from key-sort by UTF-16 code units. CORRECTED IN v7: v5 named the pair {scalar value, UTF-8 bytes}, which cannot differ -- measured exhaustively over all 1112064 valid Unicode scalars, ZERO inversions; UTF-8 byte order IS Unicode scalar-value order, on characters and on strings. The caveat as written was VACUOUS: it disclosed a limitation that does not exist. The pair that genuinely diverges is {scalar == UTF-8} versus {UTF-16 code units, as RFC 8785 JCS specifies}, first differing at U+FFFF vs U+10000, with settling vector keys U+E000 and U+10000 (scalar/UTF-8 emit U+E000 first; UTF-16 emits U+10000 first, its surrogate pair opening 0xD800 < 0xE000). See canonical-json-profile.v1#$.undeterminedRegister.UR-1, which remains OPEN. AND THE DEPENDENCY REMAINS OPEN, because a reproduced VALUE is not a DEFINED PROFILE: 'opensip-canonical-json-v1' is still named exactly once by evidence.v10 and defined nowhere in it, and no artifact states which object it canonicalises. See independentSourceReproduction.evaluationProofBundleCasRefReproduction for the measurement.
